def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Split at a uniform-color divider.
    if any(all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid) for c in range(w)):
        c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
        left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
        right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        left = [row[-width:] for row in left]
        right = [row[:width] for row in right]
        common = set(sum(left, [])) & set(sum(right, []))
        color = next(iter(common))
        return [[3 if color != 6 and left[r][x] == right[r][x] == color else color
                 for x in range(width)] for r in range(h)]

    r = next(r for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]))
    top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
    height = min(len(top), len(bottom))
    top = top[-height:]
    bottom = bottom[:height]
    common = set(sum(top, [])) & set(sum(bottom, []))
    color = next(iter(common))
    return [[3 if top[y][x] == bottom[y][x] == color else color
             for x in range(w)] for y in range(height)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find a full uniform divider, preferring the one nearest the grid's center.
    dividers = []
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            dividers.append(("v", c, abs(c - (w - 1) / 2)))
    for r in range(h):
        if all(value == grid[r][0] for value in grid[r]):
            dividers.append(("h", r, abs(r - (h - 1) / 2)))

    direction, pos, _ = min(dividers, key=lambda x: x[2])

    if direction == "v":
        left = [row[:pos] for row in grid]
        right = [row[pos + 1:] for row in grid]
        width = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
        left = [row[-width:] for row in left]
        right = [row[:width] for row in right]
        shared = set(sum(left, [])) & set(sum(right, []))
        background = min(shared)
        return [
            [3 if left[r][c] == background and right[r][c] == background
             else background for c in range(width)]
            for r in range(h)
        ]

    top, bottom = grid[:pos], grid[pos + 1:]
    height = min(len(top), len(bottom))
    top, bottom = top[-height:], bottom[:height]
    shared = set(sum(top, [])) & set(sum(bottom, []))
    background = min(shared)
    return [
        [3 if top[r][c] == background and bottom[r][c] == background
         else background for c in range(w)]
        for r in range(height)
    ]
